label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User-controlled 'seg' parameter flows directly into redirect URL without sanitization. Resolved sink value: https://<host>/<seg> where seg = request.getParameter('seg') (defaults to 'home'). Although host is validated via regex, the path segment 'seg' accepts arbitrary user input enabling path traversal within safe.com domain.

evidence.note: User input 'seg' from request.getParameter flows to redirect URL without validation
